prompt.text:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the one frame(s) of the falling SPREAD BOMB shot — a round orange-brown bomb shell plunging through the air before it bursts — one clear ball-shaped subject seen whole. The sheet is one cell holding this one bomb.

Design identity to keep exactly — the SPREAD BOMB: a round cartoon bomb shell, a perfect sphere of exactly 125 px across sitting dead-centre in its 256×256 cell with a wide even band of flat key all around it. A hot orange body (#e86018) with a broad amber-yellow lit face toward the upper-left (#f8c030), a small white specular glint (#ffffff) high on that lit side, and a deep brown-black casing line and rim (#5a3010) as a 1-px outline around the whole ball. A short dark fuse nub lies INSIDE the top of the ball's round silhouette, adding no height. Chunky, bold, readable at a glance — a heavy falling bomb, not a grenade and not a bomb burst (no fireball, no explosion, no smoke).

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 1 cells laid out as 1 ROW OF 1 (1-column by 1-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject at the same scale and position; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = THE BOMB — the round shell whole, fuse nub on top. The subject lies within aspect 0.70:1 to 1.30:1.
- ABSOLUTE BALL LAW: the whole subject spans exactly 125 px wide and 125 px tall — the ball is a 125 px circle centred in the cell, leaving at least 55 px of flat key on every side, more than the gate needs on all four borders.
- SAME SUBJECT LAW: every cell shows the SAME subject, the same size, the same materials and colours, at the same position in its cell — only the named attitude changes between cells.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 256×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 1 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: every subject sits at the exact centre of its cell at the same scale and position as the other cell — only the named state changes.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible AT that low resolution, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge
